name: kHomestuck
author: kylep33
description: Read Homestuck on your Kindle in KOReader, page by page like the website: tap the next command, open Pesterlogs, GIF panels animate, and [S] animations play with sound over Bluetooth through KinAMP (install KinAMP separately for sound). Acts download from inside the app. Adds a Homestuck book to your library and a Homestuck tile to the home screen.
